description: Answer "what does this cost in total, delivered?" — items, the exact checkout shipping tier, any running promotion and the total in EUR, for any of the 219 destination countries (all 27 EU countries plus Monaco, US, CH, AU, NZ, HK, SG, LI, IL, AE, SA, QA, KW, CA, PR, CL, GB, MX, NO, PH, MY, CO, PE, IS, OM, BH, EC, CR, KR, ZA, MA, BR, TW, TH, JP, IN, DO, GT, SV, PA, HN and 151 more countries worldwide; for the US the import duties are included). Pass the same SKU twice for quantity 2. Includes a checkoutUrl. Also answers "when will it arrive?": `delivery` gives the business days for this basket to that country and the estimated arrival dates (earliest, latest), as the checkout shows them. And "will it be there for Christmas?": in the gift season `delivery.holidays` lists the last day to order (orderBy) for that country's next gift occasion and for Christmas — St Nicholas, Christmas Eve, Three Kings' Day — with the day the parcel arrives before (arriveBefore). For a country with its own store and currency (US → USD, CH → CHF, AU → AUD, NZ → NZD, HK → HKD, SG → SGD, IL → ILS, AE → AED) the quote also carries `local` (the same amounts in that currency at the fixed shop rate the store charges) and `storeUrl` (that country's store); item URLs then point to the product pages in that store.
